label_semantics: Class 1 = Benign, class 0 = Malicious (target column is named 'Benign' in the training script)
how_determined: The training script fits SelectFromModel but never saved it, and the CSV was not provided. The 7 columns were inferred from the trained trees' split thresholds (e.g. Machine splits at (0x14C+0x8664)/2 = 17368; DebugSize splits at multiples of 28; DllCharacteristics splits at bitmask values) plus SelectFromModel's order-preserving behaviour, then sanity-checked on real benign PE files. Run scripts/recover_feature_selection.py with the original CSV to replace this with a verified selection.
